headline: Names a post office building in Georgetown, South Carolina after Joseph Hayne Rainey, a former congressman.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1101 Charlotte Street in Georgetown, South Carolina. The building will be called the Joseph Hayne Rainey Memorial Post Office Building. It is a ceremonial change that honors Rainey and does not change postal services or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 6, 2021, and the name change took effect on that date.
